Definition: to chastise, literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence, to instruct
BiblicalUsage: 1) to chasten, discipline, instruct, admonish; 1a)(Qal); 1a1) to chasten, admonish; 1a2) to instruct; 1a3) to discipline; 1b) (Niphal) to let oneself be chastened or corrected or admonished; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to discipline, correct; 1c2) to chasten, chastise; 1d) (Hiphil) to chasten; 1e) (Nithpael) to teach
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
